thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 10/23/2018: LOGI, SAP, CDNS, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 10/23/2018: LOGI, SAP, CDNS, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -1.47%
AAPL: -1.72%
IBM: -0.97%
CSCO: -1.40%
GOOG: -1.60%
Tuesday's pre-market trade saw declining technology stocks.
Early movers include:
(-) Logitech International S.A ( LOGI ), which was down by over 9% after it reported fiscal Q2 adjusted earnings that were better-than-expected on improved revenues which were shy of forecasts compiled by Capital IQ.
(+) Cadence Design Systems ( CDNS ) was advancing by more than 8% as it reported Q3 non-GAAP earnings of $0.49 per share, up from $0.35 per share in the year-ago quarter and better than the analyst consensus of $0.41 per share on Capital IQ.
In other sector news:
(-) SAP ( SAP ) was down by almost 1.5% after it said five new machine learning services are planned for the remainder of the year: scene text recognition, customizable image segmentation, customizable text feature extraction, cloud text-to-speech by Google, and cloud speech-to-text by Google.
